image_description: A close-up portrait of an orangutan clinging to a tree trunk. The subject has characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and a broad face with dark eyes. One arm is raised high, gripping the tree, while the other is partially obscured by foreground branches. The background consists of blurred green foliage and tree bark.
